snippet.title: AZTEC MAYHEM! (SAGE 2025 TRAILER)
snippet.description:
"GOOBER! GET THE CAMERA, WE ARE GOING ON STAGE NOW!"

Download link: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/aztec-mayhem-sage-2025-demo.2613/

---

Aztec Mayhem is a FAST-PACED, FRENETIC AND A GOOFY Top-Down Shooter, being heavily inspired by games like ULTRAKILL, PIZZA TOWER, ENTER THE GUNGEON AND OTHER ONES!

Play as GOOBER, a little slime that SOMEHOW broke into a god's temple... some call him QUETZALCOATL. For years and years, he was the god of the Winds, Wisdom and wazzits. Humans would revere to him, and look up to his image, until one day, he suddendly HAD GONE MISSING. No one knew what happened to him, but behind the scenes, on the day he went missing, something bad had happened. SMALLER GODS, who were in a group he calls the MASKED TRIBE, suddendly attacked him. Quetzalcoatl, who was relaxing that day and got caught off-guard, was quickly out-numbered and had lost the battle. But, instead of killing him, they trapped him in a statue of himself, and stole ALL of his powers. NOW, after THOUSANDS OF YEARS, his messiah has come. ITS TIME FOR GOOBER TO TAKE THIS INTO HIS OWN HANDS, AND FINISH THIS MESS, ONCE AND FOR ALL!

Your job is simple.

GET IN. KILL EVERYONE. TRAP THE TEMPLE'S GOD. GET OUT.

SO WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? GO OUT THERE, GOOBER, AND CAUSE SOME MAYHEM, SON!


---
